## Changes
- **Downloads: Active by default** – the qBittorrent list on the Downloads tab now opens filtered to **Active** torrents (those currently downloading or uploading) instead of *All*. The other filters are still one click away.

## Upgrade

**Docker**
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/moordrak/arrhub:1.6.2   # or :latest
docker compose up -d                          # if you use docker-compose.yml
```

**Proxmox LXC** (on the Proxmox host)
```bash
pct exec <CTID> -- bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

**Debian / Ubuntu**
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

Your existing `config.json` is kept.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/moordrak/arrhub/compare/v1.6.1...v1.6.2
